note: On a prairie point on the south shore of Lake Sakakawea, beside Garrison Dam near Pick City. Three modern loops among shelterbelts, the open grass Far Loop on the southeast point, and Fishing Point's grass sites on the west bluff edge. Full-service marina with a store and gas dock, two boat ramps, fish-cleaning station, swim beach and pontoon rentals; the North Country Trail's western end starts in the park. Only Fishing Point sites 241, 242 and 244 are on the water (20-40 m over open grass); the other loops sit back from the shore. --Claude
summary: Park page + reserveNDparks: 193 sites (140 modern 50-amp + water $25/$30 Sat, 10 modern group, 43 primitive grass $15 that take RVs), showers, flush toilets, dump, marina store; base $15 stands. Neighbouring 240, 243, 245-249 are 50-90 m back. The main loops are not on-water: Sanish group sites GR1-GR4 ~130 m from the east bluff edge, Vanhook 107-111 ~60 m from the north bluff edge with the water ~100 m+ below, Far Loop 232 ~60 m from the east bluff and 212 ~100 m from the south cove's water. If lakefront is not wanted for three sites, lakeview stands (Vanhook's north end and Fishing Point overlook the lake).
